other_conditions: The industrial unit must have availed a loan from a financial institution for creation of fixed assets and working capital
Production must have commenced on or after 2-8-2004 for the first eligibility set
Production must have commenced on or after 24-8-2011 for the second eligibility set
For the second eligibility set, the loan must have been availed on or after 24-8-2011
Financial institutions include PIPDIC, other government corporations, scheduled banks, co‑operative banks and government co‑operative societies
Eligibility category noted in source: Women
Eligibility category noted in source: Physically Handicapped
Eligibility category noted in source: Ex-Servicemen
Eligibility category noted in source: Thrust Area Industry
Eligibility category noted in source: IT Sector Industry
benefits_summary: Provides a 25% interest subsidy on loans for eligible industrial units, capped at ₹75,000 per year (or ₹5,00,000 per year for certain categories) for up to five years.
